question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

A person who leaves his native country to settle in another
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'** i.e. **'Emigrant'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase given is **"a person who leaves his native country to settle in another".** This is describing a person who is moving from their home country to live in a different country.
 
• The most appropriate word from the given options is: **'Emigrant'.**
 
• **Emigrant: **An emigrant is a person who leaves their own country in order to settle permanently in another.(प्रवासी)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Emigrant'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Explanation of other options:
 
 
• **Itinerant: **An itinerant is a person who travels from place to place. (घुमक्कड़)
 
• **Domicile:** Domicile is a place where someone lives or resides.(निवास)
 
• **Nomad:** A nomad is a member of a community of people who live in different locations, moving from one place to another. (ख़ानाबदोश)
